plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta exposure, aiming for lower drawdowns. However, potential upside is also limited.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name mandate.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality new name. Expect moderate drawdowns with potential for steady growth.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name mandate.
